name: com.forexnewsradar/mcp
title: ForexNewsRadar — FX & Gold Macro Impulse & VETO Shield
description: Free live EUR/USD (no key) + Gold & 18-pair quant BUY/SELL macro impulses & T-5m VETO shields.

tools.name: check_prop_trade_gate
tools.description: Instant pre-trade safety check for any of the 18 FX, Gold (XAUUSD / GOLD) & Silver (XAGUSD / SILVER) pairs (broker suffixes like EURUSD.pro or XAUUSDm normalized automatically). Returns boolean prop_safe_to_trade (enforces T-5m PRE_NEWS blackout, 5m post-release Restricted News Window, and Whipsaw/Collision/Foreign Noise/Toxic Window VETO shields), directional bias (BUY | SELL | NEUTRAL), wait_seconds countdown, and standardized surprise_z. EUR/USD works live with zero key (30 req/min); optional FNR_API_KEY unlocks Gold & all 18 pairs (240 req/min).

symbol.description: Instrument symbol (e.g. "XAUUSD", "GOLD", "EURUSD", "GBPUSD", "USDJPY", or broker symbol like "EURUSD.pro"). Defaults to "EURUSD".

prop_account.description: True (default) enforces strict prop-firm T-5m pre-news and 5m post-release Restricted News Windows (FTMO, FundingPips, The5ers). False checks raw directional liquidity safety only.

tools.name: get_pair_telemetry
tools.description: Full real-time macro telemetry for one FX or Metals instrument: live_state (CLEAR | PRE_NEWS | BUY | SELL | VETO), agent_guidance, next scheduled Tier-1 catalyst countdown, recent macro releases (Actual vs Forecast, standardized surprise_z in sigma, Quant Model notes, ACTIVE vs SETTLED lifecycle), and recent Live ECN Portfolio trades.

max_releases.description: Maximum recent macro releases to return (1..15, default 5).

tools.name: list_radar_pairs
tools.description: Snapshot of all 18 monitored FX Majors, JPY Crosses, Gold (XAUUSD), and Silver (XAGUSD) across Tokyo, London, and New York sessions. Returns live EUR/USD for free without a key (plus locked stubs for #2..#18), or live verdicts for all unlocked scopes on your FNR_API_KEY.

filter.description: Optional board filter by unlock state, active signals, or currency/metals leg.

compact.description: True (default) returns lean multi-pair status objects; false includes latest release & trade summaries.

tools.name: get_macro_feed
tools.description: Unified stream of upcoming Red-Folder macro events (scheduled_at, starts_in_sec, pre_veto_minutes), active VETO/PRE_NEWS locks, and recent macro prints scoped to your unlocked pairs. Supports optional currency or symbol filtering.

currency.description: Optional ISO currency code filter (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, CAD, CHF, NZD).

limit.description: Maximum historical releases to include (0..25, default 8).

tools.name: get_entitlement_status
tools.description: Introspects your active ForexNewsRadar MCP connection: Free EUR/USD Mode (no key required, 30 req/min per IP) or active FNR_API_KEY unlocked pair scopes (Single Pair or All 18 Pairs), expiration timestamp, and per-minute rate-limit quota (240 req/min).
